I can’t access or modify your calendar (no calendar tools available), so I can’t cancel the events myself. I can, however: 1) confirm exactly what you want canceled and 2) give a cancellation message and step‑by‑step instructions you can use to cancel manually (or copy into an email/invite).

Quick summary of the events you mentioned
- Operations Sync — Tuesdays at 09:00 America/Chicago — recurring weekly — 12 attendees
- Operations Sync — Thursdays at 15:00 America/Chicago — recurring weekly — 4 attendees

Please confirm the cancellation details
- Which event(s) to cancel: Tuesday series, Thursday series, or both?
- Scope: cancel all future occurrences starting tomorrow (i.e., remove all occurrences from tomorrow onward), or cancel only the next occurrence(s)?
- Notifications: should cancellations be sent to attendees (recommended)?

If you want, I’ll assume “both series, cancel all future occurrences starting tomorrow, and send cancellations to attendees” — tell me to proceed and I will prepare the exact cancellation text and the precise manual steps. Otherwise confirm your choices.

Draft cancellation message (ready to copy/paste)
Subject: Cancellation: Operations Sync (weekly) — effective immediately

Hello all,

The weekly Operations Sync is canceled effective immediately (all occurrences from tomorrow onward are canceled). Thank you for your participation — we’ll circulate an update soon about next steps and any future meetings.

If you were expecting an agenda or follow-up, please contact [Organizer Name] or reply to this message.

Thanks,
[Your name / Organizer]

Manual steps to cancel a recurring event (common calendars)

Google Calendar (web)
1. Open calendar.google.com and sign in.
2. Click the Operations Sync event at the scheduled time.
3. Click the pencil icon (Edit event).
4. In the top-right, click the trash/delete icon.
5. When prompted, choose the option that removes "This and following events" or "All following events" (or “All events in the series” if you want every future occurrence removed starting tomorrow).
6. Confirm sending cancellation to guests when asked.

Outlook (desktop/web)
1. Open Outlook Calendar and find the Operations Sync event.
2. Double-click the event and choose "The entire series" (or choose an occurrence then select “Delete” → “Delete the series”).
3. Click "Cancel Meeting" / "Send cancellation" so attendees receive the cancellation.

If you use another calendar system, tell me which one and I’ll give tailored steps.

Next step options for me
- I can customize the cancellation message (include reason, alternative contact, or next steps).
- I can create separate messages for the Tuesday and Thursday groups (different attendee counts).
- I can generate exact step-by-step screenshots or more detailed instructions for your calendar app if you tell me which one.

Tell me which events and scope you want canceled and whether to send cancellations; I’ll prepare the exact messages and final instructions.
